title: Replace ADO Data Access with Entity Framework Core
problem_statement: Legacy ADO 2.5 COM objects are incompatible with .NET Core and pose security risks
risk_if_unaddressed: Application cannot run on modern .NET runtime, potential SQL injection vulnerabilities
suggested_approach: Create Entity Framework DbContext, map ADO Recordsets to POCO models, implement repository pattern
success_criteria: All database operations use parameterized queries
Entity Framework migrations handle schema changes
Unit tests cover all data access operations

title: Convert VB6 Forms to ASP.NET Core Razor Pages
problem_statement: VB6 forms with MDI interface need web-compatible UI implementation
risk_if_unaddressed: Complete loss of user interface functionality, business process disruption
suggested_approach: Create Razor Pages for each form, implement server-side validation, preserve business logic flow
success_criteria: All form fields and validations preserved

title: Implement Modern Authentication System
problem_statement: Custom VB6 login form lacks modern security standards and integration capabilities
risk_if_unaddressed: Security vulnerabilities, compliance failures, integration limitations
suggested_approach: Implement ASP.NET Core Identity with JWT tokens, add MFA support, integrate with enterprise SSO

title: Migrate Shared Module Logic
problem_statement: VB6 standard module contains shared business logic that needs .NET implementation
risk_if_unaddressed: Loss of critical business logic, calculation errors, process failures
suggested_approach: Create .NET service classes, implement dependency injection, add comprehensive unit tests
success_criteria: 100% unit test coverage for business logic
